## Taiwanese Basic Statistics Area (BSA) Risk Prediction

As dengue epidemics in Taiwan are results of imported cases from circulating dengue transmission in Southeast Asia,
we capitalise on our Southeast Asian interprovincial risk state model to generate "exporter" regions
and "importer" regions into our Taiwanese BSA model. A BSA is the smallest unit of census data the Taiwanese
Government keeps track of.

The model would jointly consider international mobility, local mobility, BSA environment suitability,
and BSA population demographic to predict elevated risk.
